title: A planning job API with its states in SQLite
heading: A Job Is Accepted at Once, Polled, Then Fetched
cases: a submitted job gets 202, an id and a Location header; its poll reaches the solve's status, and its fetch returns the solve's result, an infeasible one included
an id the service never gave out gets 404 on poll and on fetch, with the id in the reason
fetching a job that is still solving gets 409, and 200 once it has finished
a new instance of the service on the same SQLite file still knows the job, its state and its result
a solve that raises leaves its job failed with the error, and the next job still runs
a request with a misspelt field is refused, not solved with the default budgets
